mapper.select: SELECT lr.id AS request_id, lr.question, lr.status, us.id AS user_id, us.username, us.email, r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.description FROM list_request lr LEFT OUTER JOIN user_profile us ON lr.user_profile_id = us.id left outer join role r on r.id = us.role_id

SELECT lr.id, lr.username, lr.email, lr.question, lr.user_profile_id, lr.status FROM list_request lr WHERE lr.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') OR lr.question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') ORDER BY lr.id;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO list_request (username, email, question, status, user_profile_id) SELECT username, email, #{question}, #{status}, user_profile.id FROM user_profile WHERE id = #{user_profile.id}
